b_c1.q: 2023 英二 · 动态图（一条线一直升 / 一直降）
b_c1.eg: The chart above illustrates the changes in Chinese residents' health literacy level from 2012 to 2021, during which it rose steadily.
b_c1.egzh: 上方折线图展示了 2012—2021 年我国居民健康素养水平的变化，其间该水平稳步上升。

b_c10.q: 2026 英一 · 双图表（一左一右两张）
b_c10.eg: The chart on the left illustrates consumers' attitudes towards elderly-care robots, while the chart on the right lists their major concerns about such robots.
b_c10.egzh: 左图展示消费者对养老机器人的态度，右图列出他们对此类机器人的主要顾虑。

b_c12.q: 2026 英一 · 双图表拉长版（总分结构）
b_c12.eg: The two charts present consumers' responses to elderly-care robots: the pie chart shows their acceptance rates, while the bar chart on the right lists their major concerns.
b_c12.egzh: 两张图表共同呈现消费者对养老机器人的反应：饼图是接受度，右侧柱状图是主要顾虑。

b_c13.q: 兜底 · 图看不懂、时间紧（有年份变化）
b_c13.eg: The chart above provides information about Chinese residents' spending habits from 2015 to 2020.
b_c13.egzh: 上方图表提供了 2015—2020 年间我国居民消费习惯的相关信息。（示范）

b_c4.q: 2019 英二 · 动态图（有升有降，多变量）
b_c4.eg: The chart above illustrates the changes in graduates' choices from 2013 to 2018, among which the rise in the proportion pursuing further study was the most striking.
b_c4.egzh: 上方柱状图展示了 2013—2018 年毕业生去向选择的变化，其中选择深造比例的上升最为显著。

b_c5.q: 2019 英二 · 一升一降（两个变量走向相反）
b_c5.eg: As reflected in the chart, graduates' choices moved in opposite directions from 2013 to 2018, the proportion entering the workforce falling while that pursuing further study rising.
b_c5.egzh: 如图所示，毕业生去向在 2013—2018 年间走向相反：就业比例下降，而深造比例上升。

b_c7.q: 2024 英二 · 静态图（只有占比，没有年份趋势）
b_c7.eg: The bar chart above presents the distribution of students' gains from the labor practice course, with acquiring relevant knowledge accounting for the largest share.
b_c7.egzh: 上方柱状图呈现了劳动实践课学生收获的分布，其中「获得相关知识」所占份额最大。

b_c9.q: 2024 英二 · 静态图 · 各项差距悬殊时
b_c9.eg: The chart above reveals a striking disparity in students' gains, with the proportions ranging from 32.6% to 91.3%.
b_c9.egzh: 上方图表揭示了学生收获中的显著差距，各项占比从 32.6% 到 91.3% 不等。

b_d1.q: 2019 英二 · 动态细节（三个数据配三种动词 + 副词）
b_d1.eg: To be specific, the percentage of graduates entering the workforce decreased remarkably from 68.1% to 60.7%. However, the proportion pursuing further study climbed significantly from 26.3% to 34.0%. Meanwhile, the proportion starting a business rose slightly, from 1.3% to 2.6%.
b_d1.egzh: 具体而言，直接就业的毕业生比例从 68.1% 大幅降至 60.7%；然而，深造比例从 26.3% 显著升至 34.0%；同时，创业比例从 1.3% 小幅升至 2.6%。

b_d2.q: 单变量 · 只强调增量 / 减量（示范）
b_d2.eg: The proportion of consumers choosing electric vehicles was 5% in 2018, compared with 20% in 2023, showing an increase of 15 percentage points.
b_d2.egzh: 选择电动车的消费者比例 2018 年为 5%，2023 年为 20%，增长了 15 个百分点。（示范）

b_d3.q: 倍数关系 · 同一变量两个年份（示范）
b_d3.eg: The number of residents in the city in 2023 was nearly twice that in 2013.
b_d3.egzh: 该市 2023 年的居民数量接近 2013 年的两倍。（示范）

b_d4.q: 2024 英二 · 静态细节 + 排名（只写前两项）
b_d4.eg: To be specific, the percentages of students who acquired relevant knowledge, improved practical skills and felt comfortable account for 91.3%, 84.8% and 54.4% respectively. Notably, acquiring relevant knowledge tops the list, at 91.3%, followed by improving practical skills at 84.8%.
b_d4.egzh: 具体而言，获得相关知识、提高实践技能、心情舒畅的学生比例分别为 91.3%、84.8%、54.4%；其中获得相关知识以 91.3% 居首，其次是 84.8% 的提高实践技能。

b_d5.q: 静态倍数 · 同一年份两个变量对比（示范）
b_d5.eg: The percentage of students choosing online courses was about 1.8 times that of those choosing offline ones in 2024.
b_d5.egzh: 2024 年选择线上课程的学生比例约为选择线下课程的 1.8 倍。（示范，数字按题目换）

b_e1.q: 2023 英二 · 数据 → 现象 的过渡句
b_e1.eg: It is apparent from the statistics that health literacy has become a growing concern among Chinese residents.
b_e1.egzh: 从这些数据可以明显看出，健康素养已成为我国居民日益关注的问题。

b_e4.q: 备用过渡 · 冒号后接完整现象句（示范）
b_e4.eg: The chart clearly communicates its intended meaning: elderly-care robots are winning public acceptance.
b_e4.egzh: 图表清楚传达了它的意图：养老机器人正获得公众认可。（示范）

b_e5.q: 2026 英一 · 态度型图表（新技术 / 新观念 / 新生活方式）
b_e5.eg: Elderly-care robots have drawn growing attention from the public, with safety as their top concern.
b_e5.egzh: 养老机器人已受到公众越来越广泛的关注，安全是首要关切。

b_e6.q: 2026 英二 · 某现象正变得普遍（户外活动 / 在线学习）
b_e6.eg: Online learning is becoming prevalent among college students nowadays.
b_e6.egzh: 如今在线学习在大学生中正变得盛行。

b_e8.q: 实体行业（快递 / 旅游）· 近年快速发展
b_e8.eg: Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of the express delivery industry.
b_e8.egzh: 近年来快递业得到了快速发展。

b_f1.q: 所有图表题 · 第二段开头（英一写三点，英二 2~3 点）
b_f1.eg: Three key reasons, from my perspective, account for this phenomenon.
b_f1.egzh: 在我看来，有三点主要原因促成了这一现象。

b_f5.q: 身边举例 · 劳动实践 / 合作类（讲义填法示范）
b_f5.eg: To begin with, for instance, my roommate Kevin is passionate about practical courses, which helps him cultivate practical skills and a spirit of cooperation. Consequently, he earns the respect of our entire class.
b_f5.egzh: 首先，例如我的室友 Kevin 热衷于实践类课程，这帮助他培养了实践技能与合作精神；因此他赢得了全班同学的尊重。

b_f6.q: 家乡举例 · 2024 英一城市公园（按范文改写）
b_f6.eg: For instance, my hometown, a livable city, places a high priority on building parks, which enables residents to exercise outdoors every day.
b_f6.egzh: 例如我的家乡，一座宜居城市，高度重视公园建设，这让居民每天都能在户外锻炼。（按范文改写）

b_f7.q: 2026 英二 · 户外活动（从句说理，最万能）
b_f7.eg: What's more, definitely no one can deny the fact that outdoor activities play a crucial role in students' physical and mental health.
b_f7.egzh: 其次，毋庸置疑，户外活动对学生身心健康起着关键作用。

b_f8.q: 群众路线 · 养老机器人（多数人怎么看）
b_f8.eg: To begin with, the majority of people believe that elderly-care robots will provide them with a broader platform to care for their aging parents, which relieves the burden on their families.
b_f8.egzh: 首先，大多数人认为养老机器人能为他们提供更广阔的平台去照顾年迈父母，这减轻了家庭负担。

b_f9.q: 2026 英一 · Not only 倒装（第三条原因）
b_f9.eg: Not only does the application of elderly-care robots improve the quality of life for the elderly, but it also relieves the burden on their families.
b_f9.egzh: 养老机器人的应用不仅改善了老年人的生活质量，也减轻了家庭的负担。

b_h1.q: 养老机器人 / 三类作文通用 · 第三段总结
b_h1.eg: All in all, it is not difficult to draw the conclusion that enough attention must be paid to elderly-care robots by ourselves and our community.
b_h1.egzh: 总之，我们不难得出结论：我们自身与社会都必须对养老机器人给予足够重视。

b_h5.q: 文化交流 · 倒装总结（想上分句式时）
b_h5.eg: By no means should we underestimate the profound impact of cultural exchange.
b_h5.egzh: 我们绝不应低估文化交流所产生的深远影响。

b_h6.q: 养老机器人 · 政府措施（第三段第一句）
b_h6.eg: For one thing, it is imperative for the authorities to formulate relevant regulations to ensure the safe use of elderly-care robots.
b_h6.egzh: 一方面，政府有必要制定相关法规，以确保养老机器人的安全使用。

b_h7.q: 个人措施 · 任何题目都能用（第三段第二句）
b_h7.eg: For another, ordinary individuals ought to spare no pains to attach great importance to health knowledge in daily life.
b_h7.egzh: 另一方面，普通人也应在日常生活中不遗余力地重视健康知识。

b_h8.q: 学生心理健康 · 措施方案 2（先主流做法再转折）
b_h8.eg: When it comes to concrete solutions, some people hold that schools must take responsibility for students' mental health. In fact, it is families that play a crucial role in children's psychological well-being.
b_h8.egzh: 谈到具体方案，有人认为学校必须为学生心理健康负责；事实上，正是家庭在孩子心理健全上起关键作用。

b_i1.q: 结尾套句 · 时间紧 / 字数不够直接用
b_i1.eg: In this way, hopefully, we may embrace a brighter and more promising future.
b_i1.egzh: 如此，我们有望拥抱一个更加光明、更有希望的未来。

b_j1.q: 图表专用 · 第三段不写措施、改预测趋势
b_j1.eg: For the reasons given above, we can predict that an increasing number of people will focus on health literacy, and this trend will continue in the years to come.
b_j1.egzh: 基于上述原因，可以预见将有越来越多人关注健康素养，这一趋势在未来几年仍将持续。（示范）

b_k1.q: 2004 英一 · 跑步冲线（单图，非对话）
b_k1.eg: As is symbolically depicted in the picture above, on the playground runs a young man, rushing to the finishing line.
b_k1.egzh: 如图象征性所示，操场上跑着一位年轻人，正冲向终点线。

b_k10.q: 2020 英一 · 好习惯与拖延（两幅图）
b_k10.eg: The cartoons provide us with a thought-provoking scene: the girl in the left picture is fully focused on her homework. However, in the right picture, the boy is lying on the sofa, telling himself that he will not start until the deadline.
b_k10.egzh: 两幅漫画呈现了一个发人深省的场景：左图女孩全神贯注做作业；而右图男孩躺在沙发上，告诉自己拖到最后一刻才开始。

b_k12.q: 2024 英一 · 一图一表（图画 + 图表叠加）
b_k12.eg: As is vividly depicted in the cartoon and clearly shown in the chart above, a girl is sitting in front of a computer learning online, and the chart illustrates the popularity of online courses over the past decade.
b_k12.egzh: 正如上方漫画生动描绘、图表清楚展示的那样，一位女孩坐在电脑前在线学习；图表则展示了近十年在线课程的普及程度。

b_k13.q: 2024 英一 · 一图一表备用写法
b_k13.eg: The cartoon above depicts a girl learning online at home, while the chart below illustrates the growing popularity of online courses.
b_k13.egzh: 上方漫画描绘一位女孩在家在线学习，下方图表展示在线课程日益普及。（示范）

b_k14.q: 2004 英一 · 图画第一段收尾（主题阐述）
b_k14.eg: The primary intention of the drawing is to remind the whole society that perseverance is of vital importance.
b_k14.egzh: 这幅画的主要意图是提醒全社会：坚持至关重要。
